text.text: The first electroacoustic loudspeaker unit in Norway was built at the technical University in Trondheim by Vebjørn Tandberg, who later founded Tandbergs Radiofabrikk

media.url: image/1930-The first electroacoustic loudspeaker.jpg

text.text: The owner of Radionette, Jan Wessel decided to start making loudspeaker units for his own production of radio sets. C.C. Nørgaard Madsen was employed as a designer

media.url: image/1948-The owner of Radionette.jpg

text.text: Wessel and Madsen decided to separate the loudspeaker and radio business in order to be able to sell loudspeakers to other radiomanufacturers in Norway and abroad
The company moved to Moss

media.url: image/1951-The company moved to Moss.jpg

text.text: The closed and totally shielded TV-magnet system was invented
Scandinavian Electro Acoustic Systems, or SEAS was formed as a limited company with two shareholders, J. Wessel and C.C. Nørgaard Madsen
Wessel and Nørgaard Madsen bought Videbæk Højttalerfabrik from Nørgaard Madsens father
The first SEAS Hi-Fi 8" and 10" woofers with rubber surround were designed and put into production. One of the very first 1.5 inch soft dome tweeters was designed and introduced to the world market

media.url: image/1968-The first SEAS Hi-Fi 8 and 10 woofers.jpg

text.text: One of the worlds most successful loudspeakers, Dynaco A25 was designed by SEAS engineers. It was based on the 10" Hi-Fi woofer and the 1 1/2 " dome tweeter

media.url: image/1969-One of the worlds most successful loudsp.jpg

text.text: SEAS started supplying SONY Sweden and later SONY Europe with finished speakers

media.url: image/1970-SEAS started supplying SONY.jpg

text.text: Videbæk Højttalerfabrik was made a sister company to SEAS
Both companies experienced a major growth and in 1974 there were 250 employees in Norway and 200 in Denmark
SEAS moved into new and modern premises just outside Moss

media.url: image/1975-SEAS moved into new and modern premises.jpg

text.text: A SEAS engineer invented the patented DD-rings as part of the Dynamic Damping concept

media.url: image/1977-A SEAS engineer invented the patented DD.jpg

text.text: After some difficult years, the Danish company managed to break away from SEAS. It was named Vifa and became a competitor from one day to the next.
The employees formed a holding company and bought all SEAS shares

media.url: image/1986-The employees formed a holding company.jpg

text.text: Coaxial drivers with neodymium based dome tweeters were developed by SEAS and KEF without one knowing about the other
SEAS developed the first commercial loudspeaker unit using a cone made from cast and machined magnesium, and JAMO was the first OEM customer to utilize these.

media.url: image/1993-SEAS developed the first commercial loud.jpg

text.text: The Hexadym magnet system consisting of 6 Neodymium magnets was developed and later patented

media.url: image/1997-The Hexadym magnet system consisting of.jpg

text.text: Cooperation with Tandberg starts, where SEAS assembles speaker systems for Tandberg Video Conference Systems
SEAS developed a magnesium diaphragm dome tweeter
SEAS launched the EXOTIC line of products, utilizing the AlNiCo magnet system.

media.url: image/2007-SEAS launched the EXOTIC line of product.jpg

text.text: SEAS introduced the CURV cone series of woofers

media.url: image/2008-SEAS introduced the CURV cone series of.jpg

text.text: SEAS introduced the coax in the Excel series with cast magnesium cone. SEAS launched the Extreme line of products, with two subwoofers and a passive radiator

media.url: image/2009-SEAS introduced the coax in the Excel.jpg

text.text: SEAS launched drivers for use in high-end video conference systems

media.url: image/2010-SEAS launched drivers for use in high-en.jpg

text.text: SEAS enters the AV/video conferencing/meeting room speaker market with SEAS branded products

media.url: image/2011-SEAS enters the AV video conferencing.jpg

text.text: SEAS becomes supplier of loudspeakers to NEC Video Conference Systems

media.url: image/2012-SEAS becomes supplier of loudspeakers.jpg

text.text: SEAS developed and launched the White Diamond tweeter
SEAS joins the Sonavox Group, and are able to provide sound solutions using high-end amplification and streaming technology. SEAS developed and launched the Berylium tweeter.
SEAS became part of the Merry Electronics Co., LTD
SEAS introduced the Excel Graphene product line of woofers with Graphene treated magnesium cones.

media.url: image/2019-SEAS introduced the Excel Graphene.jpg

text.text: SEAS acquires Soundcare Superspikes

media.url: image/2020-SEAS acquires Soundcare Superspikes.jpg

text.text: SEAS introduced the Orbit line of products, with smaller drivers for video conference and smart speakers

media.url: image/2022-SEAS introduced the Orbit line.jpg

text.text: SEAS introduced the Metamodal TPCD in the Excel series.

media.url: image/2023-SEAS introduced the Metamodal TPCD.jpg

text.text: SEAS launched the Excel DXT tweeter with glass diaphragm.

media.url: image/2025-SEAS launched the Excel DXT tweeter.jpg
